Episode 223. Uncomfortable Meetings (1)
The ancient dwarf city of Piriol in the middle world.
"Mains, huh… I was expecting the enemy tribe."
Orgal came out of Piriol and stared at the Mains blocking his way. About a hundred Mains stood silently with their swords drawn.
The Mains couldn't make any expressions. Their faces had no features as if they were not fully formed yet. They were only smooth like well-crafted plaster.
"Moreover, you knew I was coming. Tell your master there's no need to unnecessarily consume his carefully crafted weapons. I came just for a talk today."
The Mains didn't respond. As if there was no other way, Orgal shrugged his shoulders and drew his sword.
"I guess there are plenty of resources left, huh?"
Swoosh!
The Mains in the front ran towards Orgal all at once, swinging their swords.
And as soon as Orgal received the first attack, he understood why the royal family had so confidently sent out the Mains.
'They're too sharp to be considered lifeless biological weapons... This is going to be quite troublesome.'
Of course, no matter how superior these biological weapons are, and even though Orgal hadn't fully recovered from the injury he had received from Paelito.
He couldn't feel any threat from a mere squad of Mains. Orgal slashed the Mains who ran at him first and spread out his sword's aura to prevent them from hastily forming an encirclement.
Of course, the Mains continued to throw themselves at Orgal as if there was no problem, even if parts of their bodies were severed or their necks fell off.
The battle continued in a pattern that looked like a one-sided massacre by Orgal. The swords of the Mains couldn't even leave a scratch on Orgal's body.
However, the moment Orgal decided that he had annihilated more than half of the Mains.
Orgal swallowed a gasp as he saw the face of a Main standing in front of him changing. The Main was taking on the face similar to a human Orgal had known a long time ago.
'...Temar!?'
Temar Runkandel.
The features sprouting out of the squirming face of the Main were almost identical to Temar's of that time. The rapidly grown long hair and the stance holding the sword also resembled Temar.
Its movement changed as well. The attack of the Main that had turned into Temar made the back of Orgal's neck go cold.
"The royal family... They ended up creating this monstrous thing with Temar's flesh."
One by one, the Mains continued to change into Temar. Orgal had already confirmed more than a dozen, and they were pressuring him much more powerfully than before.
Of course, even so, they could not compare to the real Temar Runkandel.
However, the Mains were not only mimicking Temar's appearance but also his combat style.
A magic swordsman who hardly uses magic.
It's just that he doesn't use magic with a 'form', but every sword strike simultaneously explodes with aura and magical power.
Sizzle-!
The swords of the Mains enveloped in radiance began to graze Orgal's entire body. By now, all the Mains had finished their transformation.
'After transforming like Temar, they lose their regenerative power.'
The transformed Mains seemed to have lost their super-regenerative abilities. Like humans, they bled bright red blood when cut somewhere, and the severed parts did not reattach immediately.
And, just like humans, there was a sense of will.
Ego, and the desire to kill enemies among them. It felt like fighting humans who had maximized only that.
'If these things had used soul force... it wouldn't have been a little annoying.'

Although the royal family analyzed Temar's flesh and applied it to the Mains, the soul force is not Temar's, but Soldierlet's power. Even if there were Soldierlet's flesh instead of Temar's, they couldn't have mimicked it.
Orgal knew exactly why the royal family was able to create Mains that were like mass-produced versions of Temar. They would have analyzed Temar's left arm they possessed.

'The process must have required the technology of the enemy tribe. I knew the royal family was in cahoots with them, but to receive such technological prowess... They've completely taken the initiative against those arrogant guys.'
However, there was one fact Orgal didn't know.
The royal family could not mimic the 'soul force', but instead, they added another ability to the Mains.
Fzzzz...!

As the sound of an impending thunderbolt explosion came, Orgal took a second look at the Mains in surprise. It was the thunder power used by the original Ming tribe, especially the Blue tribe. The unique deep blue thunder power of the Blue tribe instantly enveloped Orgal.
Orgal was momentarily confused. It was because he hadn't heard any news about the Blue tribe's appearance.
'I remember the Blue tribe suffered much more damage from the great snake than the enemy tribe... Are the survivors helping the royal family?'
More and more variables were revealing themselves.
First, he had to deal with all the Mains and meet the royal family in person to sort everything out. Orgal gathered his energy and wrapped his sword in an even deeper aura and magic power.
It was also bitter to continue defeating the Mains.

'It's nothing compared to the Masterpiece that Jo is developing... Of course, once the development of the Masterpiece is fully complete, it will be a tremendous weapon, but the Mains are still incomplete.'
Kinzell had invested a lot in the Masterpiece for a long time.

"But the biotic golems, the magic swordsmen created by Ziphl, were already complete, even producing special entities named Betty, Almatia, and Koon. The royal family's Min were also surpassing the Myungin.
'I need to push Jo and Bubarr more when I get back......'
Again, the number of Min was decreasing. Only about 30% of the Min remained, and nearly an hour had passed since the battle began.
"Stop, end the battle."
For the first time, the voice of a Min was heard. It was a Min who had been in the rear during the whole battle. As soon as he ordered, all the Min stopped in unison.
Orgal scrutinized the Min.
That Min was hiding its energy. But even if it hid its energy, even if it was hidden by clothes, Orgal recognized it clearly.
[It's a pity. A Min with Tamer's left arm and a Blue Race's heart.]

While other Min were made by analyzing the information left in Tamer's left arm, this entity had his left arm transplanted. Although he couldn't tell whose Blue Race heart it was, he felt at least a Two Kings-level nerve from the current Myung Wang race.
"Orgal, why did you come to see Firuol without notice? His Majesty never allowed your visit."
[Are you a child without roots? You're too absorbed in the emperor's game. I originally came to meet the Red Race today, not the ancient cockroaches.]
"Ancient cockroaches... That's a discomforting term. But if our royal family is a cockroach, aren't you the same, Orgal Remillias?"

Remillias, it had been a long time since he met someone who said that name. Orgal, smiling, looked at a man who had just left the city. Standing next to the Min with Tamer's left arm transplanted, he shone his pupils.
[Someone who still remembers that name, even I had forgotten until recently. You have good memory. Who are you?]
"I've had many names over a long period, but now I'm using the name Manoff Biment."
Manoff Biment, he was one of the key figures in the royal family, along with Bibol Biment.
[Did you boldly reveal your identity trusting that biotic golem with Tamer's arm transplanted?]
"That's right. If you were in full condition, I would have avoided it in advance."
Full condition.
It meant that Orgal was injured now, and even if he wasn't injured, he was not in perfect condition.
"You wouldn't be able to beat this guy now, even if it's you. Ah, let me introduce you. This is Tamer Biment, as you can see, our best Min we've created. Although there's still a lot to adjust."
[Ha ha... It's getting more ridiculous. Isn't it too reckless because Jin Lun Candle isn't here? Tamer Biment, how do you plan to take responsibility if Jin Lun Candle finds out?]

"It's okay now because he can't find us. Don't you know, Orgal? We have always survived like this, and even now we are living, aiming an invisible knife at the necks of the strong. What we are best at is survival. More than anyone else......"
Translate to English:
Ancient Cockroach.
What Orgal said was not merely an expression. The Bement Dynasty was indeed treated just like cockroaches back then.
Numerous, unpleasant, and no matter how many you kill, they always crawl back from somewhere.
[It's undeniable. In those times, when the Red-Named Tribe, the Blue-Named Tribe, and the strong of the demon world thrived, only you Melkas survived without ever being sealed.]
Melka.
That was the name that referred to the royal family in ancient times. The Melka family, synonymous with powerlessness and contempt.
But now, the Melka family, that is, the royal family, possessed a power that no faction could underestimate.
"You, from the Remilias lineage, a symbol of demon world nobility, have achieved remarkable success. You and us, we're alike in some ways, Orgal."
[The contempt the Melka family faced back then wasn't solely because of their lack of power. It would be better if you don't draw that comparison.]
"Heh heh, you originally came here to speak with the Red-Named Tribe. But instead, you encounter us. Do you understand what that implies?"
[What if I don’t?]

"It means the Red-Named Tribe is currently under our royal family's control. So if you want to negotiate, you should do it with the owner holding the leash, not the dog. And we've already provided you with top-tier information by showing you Temar Bement in person. Isn't that enough for you to attempt some sort of negotiation with Jin Run Kandel in the future?"

[It's possible. Telling Jin Run Kandel about that mine might be in your interest. Let me guess: You hope an enraged Jin Run Kandel will invest more resources against the royal family. The Barmel alliance will have to deploy a record mage to find you, and you intend to capture her by some means.]
Manoph didn't respond, just locked eyes with Orgal.

[But you seem to not understand Jin Run Kandel at all. Even if I share what I saw today, do you think he will invest more of his forces in the current situation with the royal family? Especially when it doesn't help in subduing the demon world? Jin Run Kandel will swallow his rage. And when the time comes to kill you, he won't show mercy.]
Orgal turned his back.
"Ho ho, Orgal. Leaving without discussing further?"

[I won't negotiate with a Melka. I still remember the old ways. I'll use the information you provided today appropriately when the time comes. Oh, and tell that kid Bement. If he's too nosy, he might die by my hands before Jin catches him.]
"You often made several deals with our royal family before, it's amusing to hear you say such."
[That was before you all showed your true colors. I will take my leave.]
As Orgal began to walk away, Manoph smirked and said,
"Lokia Ganesto. Don't you want to hear anything about her?"
